definitions.explanation: Describes colours that are harsh and unnaturally vivid, the kind that look poisonous: a toadstool, a glaring sign, heavy make-up. Also used of speech or writing full of venom.

examples.japanese: {毒々|どくどく}しい⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧キノコだ。
{毒々|どくどく}しい⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{毒々|どくどく}しい⟦{紫色|むらさきいろ}→紫色：32406_murasakiiro⟧で、⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{気|き}になれ→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧なかった。
examples.english: The sweet was such a garish purple that I didn't feel like eating it.

notes:
Always negative. A colour described this way is too bright in an unpleasant way, not simply bright.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毒々|どくどく}しい⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: a lurid colour
- {毒々|どくどく}しい⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧: garish make-up
- {毒々|どくどく}しい⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: venomous words

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦けばけばしい→けばけばしい：33022_kebakebashii⟧: gaudy, flashy — about showiness rather than a poisonous look
- ⟦{派手|はで}→派手：03563_hade⟧: showy, loud — neutral or positive as well as negative

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {毒々|どくどく}しくなかったら
